description_for_human: AI Agent Payment Control Platform - spending controls and API monetization via the x402 protocol on Base.
description_for_model: xpay provides non-custodial payment infrastructure for AI agents using the x402 protocol (HTTP 402). Products: Smart Proxy (agent spending limits), Paywall-as-a-Service (API monetization), MCP Monetization (pay-per-tool-call for MCP servers), and xpay Hub (AI agent marketplace). Payments use USDC on Base (Coinbase L2) with ~2s settlement. The xpay Facilitator at facilitator.xpay.sh handles payment verification and settlement.
